corpus_status: Reuse the same 14 known regression prompts and gold requirements unchanged. These cases were seen during development; this is not an independent holdout or representative traffic sample. Historical response bytes and scores remain typed-v2 and are never migrated or rescored as indexed-v3.
numeric_review_rule: A numeric gold requirement without an explicit state means required. Match its value through the application-owned quantity table, never a model-authored magnitude. Matching numbers and source IDs do not prove the field's semantic role or polarity.
authorization: No request or dollar authority is granted by this plan. Freeze and qualify a production runtime, bind the complete review/scoring inputs, then obtain actual new user approval. No retries, probes, recovery baseline, firewall changes, Gemini review, fabrication or bench work are included.
